seg.notes: Basis: that quarter's earnings release Table D, three-month column, as originally reported. Segments: Aggregates, Concrete, Asphalt Mix, Cement (Cement includes calcium products; calc_* null). agg_tons = total aggregates tons incl. internal tons (customer tons include tons sold on behalf of the VPP purchaser). agg_price = freight-adjusted ASP incl. internal sales, excl. third-party VPP tons. Intersegment '-' shown as 0.0. seg_sales_total and interseg_total are computed sums of the published segment lines (no total line published). Pre-2018 presentation: total revenues = net sales + delivery revenues (seg.delivery_rev). cem_tons/cem_price are extra fields (cement tons incl. internal, $/ton). agg_cgp = published Aggregates segment cash gross profit. Q4 taken directly from the Q4-13 release three-month column (not derived).

ebitda_bridge_lines: Gain on sale of real estate and businesses

adj_items.other_label: Exchange offer costs (Martin Marietta unsolicited exchange offer, Dec-2011 to 2012)

ngaap.notes: Vulcan's EBITDA reconciliation starts from net earnings, adds income taxes (continuing ops), interest expense net, and REMOVES (earnings) loss on discontinued operations net of tax (shown in ebitda_bridge_disc_ops, signed as added), then adds DDA&A. Hence ni_vulcan + ebitda_bridge_tax + interest + total_dda differs from ebitda_pub by exactly ebitda_bridge_disc_ops; the check passes once that line is included. Adjusted EBITDA = EBITDA excluding gain on sale of real estate and businesses, restructuring charges and exchange offer costs (Martin Marietta unsolicited exchange offer; zero in 2013). No adjusted EPS published (null). VPP: Sept-2013 Vulcan sold a percentage of future production from aggregates reserves (volumetric production payment) for $154.0m gross / $153.1m net, recorded as deferred revenue (not revenue, not gain) and amortized to revenue on unit-of-sales basis; an earlier VPP closed Dec-2012 ($73.6m net). Cash gross profit per ton $4.62 from release narrative.
